sikkhe.g: yasmā vinaye sati saddhammo tiṭṭhati, vinayo ca parivārena ganthito tiṭṭhati, parivāre ca samuṭṭhānādīni dissanti, tasmā sikkheyya parivāraṁ, uggaṇheyyāti attho.
ñāṇampi ñāṇapatho, ñāṇassa ārammaṇampi ñāṇapatho, ñāṇasahabhunopi dhammā ñāṇapatho.

kathaṁkathī puggalo sakaṅkho savilekho sadveḷhako savicikiccho ñāṇādhigamāya ñāṇaphusanāya ñāṇasacchikiriyāya, adhisīlampi sikkheyya, adhicittampi sikkheyya, adhipaññampi sikkheyya, imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkheyya, jānanto sikkheyya, passanto sikkheyya, paccavekkhanto sikkheyya, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkheyya, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhanto sikkheyya, satiṁ upaṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, cittaṁ samādahanto sikkheyya, paññāya pajānanto sikkheyya, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānanto sikkheyya, pariññeyyaṁ parijānanto sikkheyya, pahātabbaṁ pajahanto sikkheyya, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvento sikkheyya, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaronto sikkheyya ācareyya samācareyya samādāya vatteyyāti kathaṁkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe.
tāsaṁ taṇhānaṁ vinayāya paṭivinayāya pahānāya vūpasamāya paṭinissaggāya paṭipassaddhiyā adhisīlampi sikkheyya, adhicittampi sikkheyya, adhipaññampi sikkheyya.
yesanti rūparāgassa saddarāgassa gandharāgassa rasarāgassa phoṭṭhabbarāgassa.

satimā puggalo yesaṁ rūparāgassa saddarāgassa gandharāgassa rasarāgassa phoṭṭhabbarāgassa vinayāya paṭivinayāya pahānāya vūpasamāya paṭinissaggāya paṭipassaddhiyā adhisīlampi sikkheyya adhicittampi sikkheyya adhipaññampi sikkheyya, imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkheyya.
, ñāṇadassanañāṇādhigamanatthaṁ tisso sikkhā sikkheyyāti vuttaṁ hoti.
yesaṁ upaṭṭhitassati hutvā vinayanatthaṁ tisso sikkhā sikkheyya.
, ñāṇadassanañāṇādhigamanatthaṁ tisso sikkhā sikkheyyāti vuttaṁ hoti.
yesaṁ upaṭṭhitassati hutvāva vinayanatthaṁ tisso sikkhā sikkheyya.
kāyagatāsatiyogena satimā tesaṁ kāmānaṁ vūpasamāya tīsupi sikkhāsu appamatto sikkheyyāti attho.

sikkheyyā.g: yathā te kilesā tadaṅgādivasena pariccattā yathāsamudācārappavattiyā santāne pariḷāhaṁ na janenti, evaṁ kilesānaṁ vūpasamanavidhiṁ sikkheyya.

pāgabbhiyaṁ na sikkheyya na careyya na ācareyya na samādāya vatteyya, pāgabbhiyaṁ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṁ kareyya anabhāvaṁ gameyya, pāgabbhiyā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyāti pāgabbhiyaṁ na sikkheyya.
yo atthakāmo kulaputto, so pujjaphalanibbattanato attano santānaṁ punanato ca “puññan”ti laddhanāmaṁ tividhaṁ kusalameva sikkheyya niveseyya upacineyya pasaveyyāti attho.

Tassattho–paccekaṁ paripūretuṁ āvajjantopi sikkheyya, āvajjitvāpi “ayaṁ nāma sikkhā”ti jānantopi sikkheyya, jānitvā punappunaṁ passantopi sikkheyya, passitvā yathādiṭṭhaṁ paccavekkhantopi sikkheyya, paccavekkhitvā tattheva cittaṁ acalaṁ katvā patiṭṭhapentopi sikkheyya, taṁtaṁsikkhāsampayuttasaddhāvīriyasatisamādhipaññāhi sakasakakiccaṁ karontopi sikkheyya, abhiññeyyābhijānanakālepi taṁ taṁ kiccaṁ karontopi tisso sikkhāyo sikkheyya, adhisīlaṁ ācareyya, adhicittaṁ sammā careyya, adhipaññaṁ samādāya vatteyya.

sikkhethā.g: subhāsitaṁ sikkheyya, catusaccanissitaṁ dasakathāvatthunissitaṁ sattatiṁsabodhipakkhiyanissitaṁ catubbidhaṁ vacīsucaritameva sikkheyya.
yathā akusalaṁ samucchindeyya, samathavipassanādhammepi tatheva sikkheyya.

Sikkhe.g: tisso sikkhāyo adhisīlasikkhā adhicittasikkhā adhipaññāsikkhā -pa- ayaṁ adhipaññāsikkhā.
